ocr.notes: Gist readable; many letter errors (McDonough, Wash Home, $600)

title.suggested: Ben Hogan leaves St. Louis; Wash Home case against Allen to go on

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that a vagrancy charge against Ben Hogan was dropped when he agreed to leave town, and that Chief McDonough would still press the Wash Home case against Tom Allen and his associates.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Thursday Morning, December 4, 1873'; filed as Missouri Republican per rubric

facts.fact: St. Louis police chief McDonough intended to prosecute Allen and his associates in the Wash Home case over their chase after Ben Hogan, without using Hogan as a witness

notes: Article is mainly about Hogan and trainer John Sweeney leaving for Pittsburgh via Chicago; Allen appears in one sentence.
